title: 第15章 元帅之子第16章 浑水摸鱼
slug: 苟住开局长生修仙只是副业
content_zh:
离开了这位富态大人这里，林铭继续送着饭食，很快来到了第二位新人这边！
看到对方之后，林铭微微一个愣神！
不为别的，只是因为对方实在是太特别了！
对方从年龄上来看，顶多就只有十五六岁的样子，身上没有任何一点华服，反倒是穿着紧身的布衣，布衣上还带着一些补丁，双手之上有着明显的手茧，脸上也多少有一点黝黑，那是长期暴晒的结果，身上也没有任何的锁链。
此时正在牢房之中打着拳！
“嘿！哈！”
要不是在天牢之外遇到对方，林铭只会以为对方就是哪位农民的儿子，绝对不会想到对方是哪位官员的后代！
可这里是天牢，甲乙两个字号，除非丙丁字号关满了人，否则只会关押官员或者官员的后代……
这人显然也是哪一位官员的后代。
林铭按捺住心中的疑惑，依旧按照流程，将食盒放下，躬身说了一句。
“大人，请用膳！”
“谢谢。”
青年点了点头，收了拳法，同时道谢一声，向着食盒走来，一句话之后，他不想再说其他的样子，林铭也不和对方多言，从牢房走开，继续向着下一个牢房而去！
……
一小会功夫，将所有牢房都送完之后，林铭骤然觉得有些不对，他没有看到王侍郎。
王侍郎可是得罪了陈相公子，只要陈相在位一天，他就绝对不可能出狱的！
难道他人已经凉了？！
带着疑问，林铭回转后厨，见齐大厨也闲了下来，这才询问着：
“齐大厨，我看乙字号房又多了两位大人物，什么来头？！还有王侍郎怎么不见了踪影？！”
“王侍郎，你还不知道么！？昨天晚上他疯了，自己在牢房之中吃着自己的屎尿，还说着什么吃了陈公子之类的话语，吃完之后，一头撞在了牢柱上，死了！”

齐大厨先给林铭解答了一下王侍郎的事情。
“哎！”
林铭轻叹一声，点头说道：
“对王侍郎来说，也算是一种解脱！”
确实是种解脱，他生活在这个世界之中，只能待在天牢之中，每天能想的就是自己的妻女正在教坊司之中受到他人的欺辱，仇人又那般的强大，他这辈子完全没有报仇的可能！
死，对他来说，就是最好的解脱！
更何况，在死前，他疯了，还以为自己将陈相公子也一同咬死，算是了却了心中最后一点执念！
“是啊！确实是一种解脱！”
齐大厨也赞同地点点头，顺势将话题转到了那两位新人的身上。
“至于那两位新进来的大人物，可了不得，一个个背景深厚，都是我们得罪不起的，其中一位是云中书院的当代院长！”
云中书院，那是大宋的传奇书院，和齐熹的云麓书院并称为大宋的两大书院！
和齐熹的格物致知，书院之中的弟子一律走科举文官一途不同！
云中书院既讲文学，也讲武道。
除此之外，另外一个不同，就是云中书院的弟子全都是贫苦人家的孩子！
从云中书院出来的人，全都会和普通百姓打成一片！
这云中书院数代传承下来，也给大宋培养了无数名人，当世名声最大的两人，一个就是陈相，另外一个就是元帅刘武，一文一武，当今朝堂军方的两大支柱，全都是从云中书院出来的人！
云中书院的威望一时达到了顶点！
可林铭怎么记得云中书院的院长已经七老八十了呢？！
他今天看到的那位富态老者，不过就只是四五十的样子，和传说之中听到的那位完全不一样！
“哪一位是云中书院的院长？！我听说云中书院的院长不是已经七八十岁了么？！”
content_en:
After leaving this rich man, Lin Ming continued to deliver food and soon came to the second newcomer!
After seeing the other party, Lin Ming was slightly stunned!
Not for anything else, just because the other person is so special!
Judging from the age of the other party, he is only fifteen or sixteen years old at most. He does not have any fancy clothes on his body. Instead, he wears tight-fitting cloth clothes with some patches. There are obvious calluses on his hands, and his face is somewhat dark, which is the result of long-term exposure to the sun. There are no chains on his body.
At this time, he was punching in the cell!
"Hey! Ha!"
If he hadn't met the other party outside the prison, Lin Ming would have thought that the other party was the son of a farmer, and would never have thought that the other party was the descendant of an official!
But here is the Tianlao, with two sizes: A and B. Unless the numbers B and D are full, only officials or their descendants will be imprisoned...
This man is obviously a descendant of that official.
Lin Ming suppressed the doubts in his heart, still followed the procedure, put down the food box, bowed and said something.
"Sir, please have a meal!"
"Thank you."
The young man nodded, withdrew his punches, thanked him at the same time, and walked towards the food box. After saying a word, he didn't want to say anything else. Lin Ming didn't say much to him, walked away from the cell, and continued towards the next cell!
…
After a short while, after all the cells were delivered, Lin Ming suddenly felt that something was wrong. He did not see Wang Shilang.
Shilang Wang has offended Master Chen. As long as Prime Minister Chen is in office for one day, there is absolutely no way he will be released from prison!
Are others already cold? !
With questions in mind, Lin Ming turned to the kitchen and saw that Chef Qi was also idle, and then asked:
"Chef Qi, I see that there are two more big shots in room B. What are their backgrounds?! And why is Mr. Wang missing?!"
"Wang Shilang, don't you know!? He went crazy last night. He ate his own feces and urine in the cell, and said something like eating Mr. Chen. After eating, he hit his head against the prison pillar and died!"
Chef Qi first explained to Lin Ming the matter of Wang Shilang.
"Hey!"
Lin Ming sighed softly, nodded and said:
“For Mr. Wang, it’s also a relief!”
It is indeed a relief. He lives in this world and can only stay in the heavenly prison. All he can think about every day is that his wife and daughter are being bullied by others in Jiaofangsi. The enemy is so powerful. There is no possibility of revenge in his life!
Death, for him, is the best relief!
What's more, before he died, he went crazy and thought that he would bite Mr. Chen to death as well, which would be the last obsession in his heart!
"Yeah! It's a relief indeed!"
Chef Qi nodded in agreement and turned the topic to the two newcomers.
"As for the two new big shots, they are amazing. They all have profound backgrounds and we cannot afford to offend them. One of them is the contemporary dean of Yunzhong Academy!"
Yunzhong Academy, that is the legendary academy of the Song Dynasty, and together with Qi Xi’s Yunlu Academy, are known as the two major academies of the Song Dynasty!
Unlike Qi Xi's study of things and knowledge, all the disciples in the academy took the imperial examination and became civil servants!
Yunzhong Academy teaches both literature and martial arts.
In addition, another difference is that the disciples of Yunzhong Academy are all children from poor families!
Everyone who comes out of Yunzhong Academy will mingle with ordinary people!
This Yunzhong Academy has been passed down for generations, and it has also cultivated countless celebrities in the Song Dynasty. The two most famous people in the world, one is Chen Xiang, and the other is Marshal Liu Wu. One is civil and the other is military. The two pillars of the current court and military are all people who came out of Yunzhong Academy!
The prestige of Yunzhong Academy has reached its peak!
But how could Lin Ming remember that the dean of Yunzhong Academy was already 80 years old? !
He is todayThe wealthy old man Tian saw was only in his forties or fifties, completely different from the one he heard about in the legend!
"Which one is the dean of Yunzhong Academy?! I heard that the dean of Yunzhong Academy is not already seventy or eighty years old?!"
